name: brandon-valley-lunch
description: Brandon Valley Lunch: static PWA plus Netlify Functions, built on the Sioux Falls Parent template

scripts.lint: npx --yes eslint@8 --no-eslintrc -c tests/eslintrc.json app.js shared.js data.js i18n.js handbooks-es.js handbooks.js overrides.js sw.js dev-server.js netlify/functions/*.js netlify/functions/lib/*.js tests/*.js
scripts.test:unit: node tests/unit.js && node tests/unit-menu.js && node tests/unit-school.js && node tests/unit-events.js
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:journeys
